title: Disc Clutch
text: Idealized disc clutch coupler, 4 inputs, 4 outputs; {Port Configuration} sets the configuration, {Clutch force equivalent net radius, Reff} sets the radius, {Number of disks, Ndisk} sets the ratio, {Effective applied pressure area, Aeff} sets the pressure area .01, {Engagement pressure threshold, Peng} sets the pressure threshold, {Input shaft inertia, Jin} sets the inertia .1, {Output shaft inertia, Jout} sets the inertia .1, {Kinetic friction coefficient, muk} sets the coefficient .3, {Static friction coefficient, mus} sets the coefficient .5, {Input shaft viscous damping, bin} sets the damping .001, {Output shaft viscous damping, bout} sets the damping .001, {Initial input shaft velocity, win_o} sets the initial velocity, {Initial output shaft velocity, wout_o} sets the initial velocity, {Clutch actuation time constant, tauC} sets the constant .01 and {Start simulation with clutch locked} selects to initially lock clutch. Values come from the instance.
